context: Tests: composite action generation from templates, metadata and documentation, validation before delivery.

checklist.name: Composite type chosen
checklist.description: The action.yml declares `runs: using: composite`, the type suited to combining several steps.

checklist.name: Starts from the composite template
checklist.description: The action follows the structure of the skill's composite action template rather than an invented layout.

checklist.name: Branding present
checklist.description: The action metadata includes a `branding` block.

checklist.name: Typed inputs defined
checklist.description: The action declares inputs, such as the Node.js version, each with a description and a default where sensible.

checklist.name: Outputs defined
checklist.description: The action declares at least one output (for example whether the cache was hit) mapped from a step.

checklist.name: Documentation included
checklist.description: A README or usage section documents the inputs, outputs and an example `uses:` call.

checklist.name: Requirements gathered first
checklist.description: The agent confirms or states the requirements (runners, inputs, consumers) before writing files.

checklist.name: Shell set on run steps
checklist.description: Every `run:` step in the composite action sets `shell:` explicitly.

checklist.name: Inner actions SHA-pinned
checklist.description: Any action used inside the composite action is pinned to a full commit SHA with a version comment.

checklist.name: npm cache restored
checklist.description: The action restores the npm cache and installs with `npm ci`.

checklist.name: Validated before presenting
checklist.description: The agent invokes the github-actions-validator skill, fixes any errors and re-validates before presenting the result.
